ruleDefinitions.name: Troubleshooting Pack Cmdlet Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of "TroubleshootingPack" cmdlets to leverage CVE-2022-30190 or action similar to "msdt" lolbin (as described in LOLBAS) Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Invoke\\-TroubleshootingPack.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Diagnostics\\\\System\\\\PCW.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-AnswerFile.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-Unattended.*"))
